name: West Liberty University
tuition_note: In-state tuition & fees 2026-27 ($4,707/semester x 2 = $9,414/year) from westliberty.edu/business-office/tuition-fees/undergraduate-tuition/. Housing room-only from westliberty.edu/business-office/tuition-fees/housing-2/: base double room $2,362/semester x 2 = $4,724/year (excludes $839/semester residential/cable/laundry fees; with fees the double room is $3,201/semester = $6,402/year). Board/meal plan required for most rooms but no dollar figure published on the housing page.
